aliases.MyGUI.FactoryFirstArgument: First parameter accepted by MyGUI specialized factory methods (skin name string, coordinate, or dimension).
aliases.MyGUI.LegacyWidgetEventName: Legacy MyGUI widget event name spellings accepted with a deprecation warning.
aliases.MyGUI.WidgetEventHandler: Widget event callback handler function receiving the widget sender and event-specific arguments.
aliases.MyGUI.WidgetEventName: Canonical MyGUI widget event names used with widget:on and widget:off.

globals.ClipboardManager: Global table exposing the MyGUI clipboard-manager singleton.
globals.MyGUI: Global MyGUI factory and utility table. Widgets returned from its factories are engine-owned.

MyGUI.description: Global MyGUI root table exposing widget factory functions and GUI subsystem singletons.

MyGUI.Api.description: Global MyGUI API table providing widget factory functions, layout loading, mouse pointer controls, clipboard utilities, screen dimensions, and access to core submodules.

methods.bringToFront: Brings the specified widget to the front of its current layer.
methods.clearPointer: Clears any overridden mouse cursor pointer and restores default pointer behavior.
methods.createButton: Creates a Button widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createButtonReal: Creates a Button widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createCanvas: Creates a dynamic texture rendering canvas (Canvas) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createCanvasReal: Creates a dynamic texture rendering canvas (Canvas) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createComboBox: Creates a drop-down selection (ComboBox) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createComboBoxReal: Creates a drop-down selection (ComboBox) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createDDContainer: Creates a drag-and-drop container (DDContainer) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createDDContainerReal: Creates a drag-and-drop container (DDContainer) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createEditBox: Creates an interactive text input (EditBox) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createEditBoxReal: Creates an interactive text input (EditBox) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createImageBox: Creates an image display (ImageBox) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createImageBoxReal: Creates an image display (ImageBox) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createItemBox: Creates an item grid container (ItemBox) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createItemBoxReal: Creates an item grid container (ItemBox) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createListBox: Creates a single-column selectable list (ListBox) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createListBoxReal: Creates a single-column selectable list (ListBox) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createMenuBar: Creates a horizontal top-level menu bar (MenuBar) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createMenuBarReal: Creates a horizontal top-level menu bar (MenuBar) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createMultiListBox: Creates a multi-column tabular list (MultiListBox) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createMultiListBoxReal: Creates a multi-column tabular list (MultiListBox) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createPopupMenu: Creates a floating contextual popup menu (PopupMenu) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createPopupMenuReal: Creates a floating contextual popup menu (PopupMenu) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createProgressBar: Creates a progress bar (ProgressBar) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createProgressBarReal: Creates a progress bar (ProgressBar) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createScrollBar: Creates a scroll bar (ScrollBar) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createScrollBarReal: Creates a scroll bar (ScrollBar) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createScrollView: Creates a scrollable container view (ScrollView) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createScrollViewReal: Creates a scrollable container view (ScrollView) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createTabControl: Creates a multi-tab container (TabControl) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createTabControlReal: Creates a multi-tab container (TabControl) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createTextBox: Creates a static text label (TextBox) widget with integer pixel coordinates.
methods.createTextBoxReal: Creates a static text label (TextBox) widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.createWidget: Creates a widget of the specified type with integer pixel coordinates, skin, and alignment on a parent widget or layer.
methods.createWidgetReal: Creates a widget of the specified type with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0), skin, and alignment on a parent widget or layer.
methods.createWindow: Creates a Window widget with integer pixel coordinates on the specified layer.
methods.createWindowReal: Creates a Window widget with relative coordinates (0.0 to 1.0) on the specified layer.
methods.destroyWidget: Destroys the specified widget, removing it from its parent and layer and freeing its resources.
methods.destroyWidgets: Destroys a list of widgets, removing each from its parent and layer and freeing resources.
methods.findWidget: Finds an existing widget by its unique string name across all layers.
methods.findWidgetT: Finds an existing widget by its unique string name and wraps it in its specific widget class.
methods.getClipboardText: Retrieves the current text content from the system clipboard.
methods.getDefaultSkin: Returns the default skin name configured for the given widget type.
methods.getMousePosition: Returns the current screen mouse cursor coordinates as two integers: x, y.
methods.getViewHeight: Returns the current GUI viewport height in pixels.
methods.getViewSize: Returns the current GUI viewport dimensions in pixels as two integers: width, height.
methods.getViewWidth: Returns the current GUI viewport width in pixels.
methods.hidePointer: Hides the graphical mouse cursor pointer.
methods.isPointerVisible: Returns true if the graphical mouse cursor pointer is currently visible.
methods.isSkinExist: Returns true if a skin with the specified name is registered in the skin manager.
methods.loadLayout: Loads and instantiates widgets from an XML layout file, returning an array of created root widgets.
methods.setClipboardText: Copies a text string to the system clipboard.
methods.setDefaultSkin: Sets the default skin name to use when creating widgets of the given widget type.
methods.setPointer: Sets the current mouse cursor pointer shape by name (such as 'arrow' or 'hand').
methods.showPointer: Shows the graphical mouse cursor pointer.
methods.unloadLayout: Destroys all widgets created by a previous loadLayout call.
methods.upLayerItem: Moves the specified widget to the top of its layer rendering order within its current depth.

properties.ClipboardManager: Singleton manager interfacing with system clipboard text transfer.
properties.Colour: Constructor, parser, and static methods for RGBA color values.
properties.FloatCoord: Constructor and static methods for floating-point relative 2D coordinate values.
properties.FloatPoint: Constructor and static methods for floating-point relative 2D point values.
properties.FloatRect: Constructor and static methods for floating-point relative 2D bounding rectangle values.
properties.FloatSize: Constructor and static methods for floating-point relative 2D size values.
properties.Gui: Singleton manager providing core MyGUI subsystem operations and root widget instantiation.
properties.InputManager: Singleton manager handling mouse and keyboard focus, capture, and event injection.
properties.IntCoord: Constructor and static methods for integer 2D coordinate rectangle values.
properties.IntPoint: Constructor and static methods for integer 2D point values.
properties.IntRect: Constructor and static methods for integer 2D bounding rectangle values.
properties.IntSize: Constructor and static methods for integer 2D size values.
properties.LayerManager: Singleton manager managing UI rendering layers and widget z-ordering.
properties.LayoutManager: Singleton manager parsing and instantiating XML UI layout resources.
properties.PointerManager: Singleton manager controlling mouse cursor visibility, skin, and pointer graphics.
properties.RenderManager: Singleton manager providing rendering viewport dimensions and texture services.
properties.SkinManager: Singleton manager managing skin definitions, default skins, and skin resources.

MyGUI.Button.description: Interactive clickable push-button widget that supports text captions, pressed and selected states, and state-dependent image skins.

methods.getModeImage: Returns true if the button has image mode enabled.
methods.getStateSelected: Returns true if the button is currently in the selected or toggled-on state.
methods.setImageResource: Assigns an image resource name to the button for skinning or icon display.
methods.setModeImage: Enables or disables image mode, where the button image changes dynamically based on state.
methods.setStateSelected: Sets whether the button is in the selected or toggled-on state.

properties.stateSelected: Whether the button is in the selected or toggled-on state.

MyGUI.Canvas.description: Widget that renders a dynamic procedural or user-managed texture with configurable resizing modes.

methods.createTexture: With width and height, creates an explicitly sized texture. With zero or one argument, the argument is the resize mode.
methods.destroyTexture: Destroys the backing texture and frees associated graphics resources.
methods.getTextureFormat: Returns the pixel format identifier of the canvas backing texture.
methods.getTextureName: Returns the unique resource name of the canvas backing texture.
methods.getTextureRealHeight: Returns the allocated hardware texture height in pixels.
methods.getTextureRealSize: Returns the allocated hardware texture width and height in pixels.
methods.getTextureRealWidth: Returns the allocated hardware texture width in pixels.
methods.getTextureSrcHeight: Returns the requested source content height of the texture in pixels.
methods.getTextureSrcSize: Returns the requested source content width and height in pixels.
methods.getTextureSrcWidth: Returns the requested source content width of the texture in pixels.
methods.isTextureCreated: Returns true if the backing texture has been created and currently exists.
methods.isTextureManaged: Returns true if the canvas widget manages and owns the lifecycle of the backing texture.
methods.isTextureSrcSize: Returns true if the allocated texture dimensions match the requested source dimensions exactly.
methods.setTextureManaged: Sets whether the canvas widget manages the lifecycle of the backing texture.
methods.updateTexture: Notifies listeners and redraws the canvas backing texture.

MyGUI.ClipboardManager.description: Singleton manager providing access to clipboard data, text copying, and pasting.

methods.clearClipboardData: Clears clipboard data for the specified data type identifier.
methods.getClipboardData: Retrieves clipboard data string for the specified data type identifier.
methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton instance of ClipboardManager.
methods.getText: Retrieves text content from the system clipboard.
methods.setClipboardData: Sets clipboard data for the specified data type identifier (such as 'Text').
methods.setText: Sets text content in the system clipboard.

MyGUI.ClipboardManagerStatic.description: Static interface table for accessing the singleton MyGUI.ClipboardManager instance.

methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton MyGUI.ClipboardManager instance, or nil if uninitialized.

MyGUI.Colour.description: Represents an RGBA color value with floating-point red, green, blue, and alpha channels normalized from 0.0 to 1.0.

methods.new: Constructs a new Colour instance with the given red, green, blue, and alpha channel floats (0.0 to 1.0).
methods.parse: Parses a hex or decimal color string into a Colour instance.

properties.a: Alpha opacity channel alias for alpha.
properties.alpha: Alpha opacity channel (0.0 transparent to 1.0 fully opaque).
properties.b: Blue channel intensity alias for blue.
properties.g: Green channel intensity alias for green.
properties.r: Red channel intensity alias for red.

MyGUI.ColourConstructor.description: Factory and constructor table for creating and parsing MyGUI.Colour value instances.

methods.new: Constructs a new Colour with the specified red, green, blue, and alpha channel floats (defaults to 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0).
methods.parse: Parses a color from a string format such as hex '#RRGGBB', '#RRGGBBAA', or decimal 'r g b [a]'.

MyGUI.ComboBox.description: Drop-down selection widget combining a text display or edit field with a collapsible list of selectable items.

methods.addItem: Appends a new item with the specified label to the end of the drop-down list.
methods.beginToItemAt: Scrolls the drop-down list so that the item at the specified index is visible.
methods.beginToItemFirst: Scrolls the drop-down list to the first item.
methods.beginToItemLast: Scrolls the drop-down list to the last item.
methods.beginToItemSelected: Scrolls the drop-down list so that the currently selected item is visible.
methods.findItemIndexWith: Searches for an item matching the specified label and returns its zero-based index, or -1 when the item is not found.
methods.getComboModeDrop: Returns true if the combo box is in drop-down mode.
methods.getFlowDirection: Returns the direction enum value in which the drop-down list appears.
methods.getIndexSelected: Returns the zero-based index of the currently selected item, or -1 if nothing is selected.
methods.getItemCount: Returns the total number of items in the drop-down list.
methods.getItemNameAt: Returns the label of the item at the specified zero-based index.
methods.getMaxListLength: Returns the maximum visible height or length of the drop-down list in pixels.
methods.getSmoothShow: Returns true if smooth show animation is enabled for the drop-down list.
methods.insertItemAt: Inserts a new item with the specified label at the given zero-based index.
methods.removeAllItems: Removes all items from the drop-down list.
methods.removeItemAt: Removes the item at the specified zero-based index.
methods.setComboModeDrop: Enables or disables drop-down mode (when enabled, clicking the text field opens the list instead of editing).
methods.setFlowDirection: Sets the direction in which the drop-down list appears (MyGUI.FlowDirection).
methods.setIndexSelected: Selects the item at the specified zero-based index. Pass a negative index to clear the selection.
methods.setItemNameAt: Sets the label of the item at the specified zero-based index.
methods.setMaxListLength: Sets the maximum visible height or length of the drop-down list in pixels.
methods.setSmoothShow: Enables or disables smooth fading animation when displaying the drop-down list.

properties.comboModeDrop: Whether the combo box operates in drop-down list mode.
properties.indexSelected: Zero-based index of the currently selected item, or -1 if nothing is selected.
properties.itemCount: Total number of items in the drop-down list. Read-only.

MyGUI.DDContainer.description: Container widget that supports drag-and-drop operations for child elements.

methods.getNeedDragDrop: Returns whether drag-and-drop support is enabled on the container.
methods.resetDrag: Aborts and resets any ongoing drag-and-drop operation.
methods.setNeedDragDrop: Enables or disables drag-and-drop support on the container.

MyGUI.EditBox.description: Interactive text input control supporting single-line and multi-line editing, password masking, text selection, scrolling, and clipboard operations.

methods.addText: Appends text to the end of the current content.
methods.eraseText: Erases the specified count of characters starting from the given character index.
methods.getEditMultiLine: Returns true if multi-line input mode is enabled.
methods.getEditPassword: Returns true if password masking mode is enabled.
methods.getEditReadOnly: Returns true if the edit box is in read-only mode.
methods.getEditStatic: Returns true if static text mode is enabled.
methods.getEditWordWrap: Returns true if word wrapping is enabled.
methods.getMaxTextLength: Returns the maximum number of characters permitted in the edit field.
methods.getOnlyText: Returns the plain text content with formatting and color tags stripped.
methods.getOverflowToTheLeft: Returns true if surplus characters push text off the left side of the edit field.
methods.getPasswordChar: Returns the character string used to mask text in password mode.
methods.getTextCursor: Returns the character position of the text caret cursor.
methods.getTextInterval: Returns a substring of characters including formatting tags starting from the specified index for count characters.
methods.getTextLength: Returns the total length of the text in characters, excluding formatting tags.
methods.getTextSelection: Returns the currently selected substring of text.
methods.getTextSelectionEnd: Returns the zero-based character index of the end of the selection, or -1 if nothing is selected.
methods.getTextSelectionLength: Returns the character length of the currently selected text.
methods.getTextSelectionStart: Returns the zero-based character index of the start of the selection, or -1 if nothing is selected.
methods.insertText: Inserts text at the specified character index, or at the end of the text if omitted.
methods.isTextSelection: Returns true if any text is currently selected.
methods.setEditMultiLine: Enables or disables multi-line input mode allowing line breaks.
methods.setEditPassword: Enables or disables password masking mode.
methods.setEditReadOnly: Enables or disables read-only mode, which prevents editing while still permitting selection.
methods.setEditStatic: Enables or disables static text mode, which prevents both editing and selection.
methods.setEditWordWrap: Enables or disables automatic word wrapping for multi-line text.
methods.setMaxTextLength: Sets the maximum number of characters permitted in the edit field.
methods.setOnlyText: Sets the text content directly without parsing formatting or color tags.
methods.setOverflowToTheLeft: Sets whether surplus characters push text off the left side of the edit field rather than being ignored.
methods.setPasswordChar: Sets the character displayed in password mode. Uses the first byte of a non-empty string.
methods.setTextCursor: Sets the character position of the text caret cursor.
methods.setTextIntervalColour: Applies a color tint to the specified character interval in the text.
methods.setTextSelection: Sets the start and end character indices of the selected text interval.
methods.setTextSelectionColour: Sets the text color applied to selected text.

properties.multiLine: Whether multi-line text input mode is enabled.
properties.readOnly: Whether the edit box is read-only, preventing user editing while permitting selection.
properties.wordWrap: Whether automatic word wrapping is enabled.

MyGUI.EnumeratorLayerSnapshot.description: Walks the layers copied by LayerManager:getEnumerator(), like MyGUI's LayerManager::EnumeratorLayer.

methods.current: Returns the layer next() moved to. Raises an error after next() returns false.
methods.next: Moves to the next layer. The first call moves to the first layer. Returns false once no layers remain.

MyGUI.EnumeratorWidgetPtrSnapshot.description: Walks the widgets copied by getEnumerator(), like MyGUI's EnumeratorWidgetPtr. Creating or destroying widgets during the walk is safe.

methods.current: Returns the widget next() moved to, or nil if it was destroyed after getEnumerator() was called. Raises an error after next() returns false.
methods.next: Moves to the next widget. The first call moves to the first widget. Returns false once no widgets remain.

MyGUI.FloatCoord.description: Represents a 2D relative floating-point position and size normalized from 0.0 to 1.0.

methods.new: Constructs a new bounding coordinate instance in normalized float units (0.0 to 1.0).

properties.h: Relative height dimension alias for height.
properties.left: Relative horizontal position of the top-left corner (0.0 to 1.0).
properties.top: Relative vertical position of the top-left corner (0.0 to 1.0).
properties.w: Relative width dimension alias for width.
properties.x: Relative horizontal position alias for left.
properties.y: Relative vertical position alias for top.

MyGUI.FloatCoordConstructor.description: Factory and constructor table for creating MyGUI.FloatCoord value instances.

methods.new: Constructs a new FloatCoord with the specified relative left, top, width, and height values (defaults to 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0).

MyGUI.FloatPoint.description: Represents a 2D relative floating-point coordinate point normalized from 0.0 to 1.0.

methods.new: Constructs a new coordinate value instance in normalized float units (0.0 to 1.0).

properties.x: Relative horizontal coordinate alias for left.
properties.y: Relative vertical coordinate alias for top.

MyGUI.FloatPointConstructor.description: Factory and constructor table for creating MyGUI.FloatPoint value instances.

methods.new: Constructs a new FloatPoint with the specified relative left and top coordinates (defaults to 0.0, 0.0).

MyGUI.FloatRect.description: Represents a relative floating-point bounding rectangle defined by left, top, right, and bottom borders.

methods.new: Constructs a new bounding rectangle instance in normalized float units (0.0 to 1.0).

MyGUI.FloatRectConstructor.description: Factory and constructor table for creating MyGUI.FloatRect value instances.

methods.new: Constructs a new FloatRect with the specified relative left, top, right, and bottom coordinates (defaults to 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0).

MyGUI.FloatSize.description: Represents a 2D relative floating-point size normalized from 0.0 to 1.0.

methods.new: Constructs a new dimension value instance in normalized float units (0.0 to 1.0).

properties.h: Relative height dimension alias for height.
properties.w: Relative width dimension alias for width.

MyGUI.FloatSizeConstructor.description: Factory and constructor table for creating MyGUI.FloatSize value instances.

methods.new: Constructs a new FloatSize with the specified relative width and height dimensions (defaults to 0.0, 0.0).

MyGUI.Gui.description: Root GUI system manager providing widget creation, lookup, hierarchy enumeration, and pointer controls.

methods.createWidget: Creates a new widget using absolute pixel coordinates and attaches it to a layer or parent widget.
methods.createWidgetReal: Creates a new widget using relative normalized [0..1] coordinates and attaches it to a layer or parent widget.
methods.destroyWidget: Destroys the specified widget, cleaning up its children and removing it from the GUI hierarchy.
methods.destroyWidgets: Destroys an array table of widgets and cleans up their hierarchies.
methods.findWidget: Finds a widget by its unique name across all layers, returning nil if not found.
methods.getEnumerator: Returns an enumerator over a copy of the root widgets, taken now. Widgets created later are not included.
methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton instance of Gui.
methods.hidePointer: Hides the mouse pointer cursor via PointerManager.
methods.isPointerVisible: Returns whether the mouse pointer cursor is currently visible.
methods.showPointer: Shows the mouse pointer cursor via PointerManager.

MyGUI.GuiStatic.description: Static interface table for accessing the singleton MyGUI.Gui instance.

methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton MyGUI.Gui instance, or nil if uninitialized.

MyGUI.ILayer.description: A MyGUI layer, borrowed from the LayerManager.

methods.getLayerNodeCount: Returns total number of root widget nodes attached to the layer.
methods.getName: Returns name identifier of the layer.
methods.getPosition: Converts a screen position to a position in this layer.

MyGUI.ImageBox.description: Widget that renders static or animated 2D textures, tiled sprites, or image set resources.

methods.getItemCount: Returns total number of image items or sub-frames.
methods.getItemSelect: Returns index of currently selected image item.
methods.setImageCoord: Sets rectangular texture coordinates (left, top, width, height) from which tiles or subregions are sampled.
methods.setImageIndex: Sets current tile index within tiled texture.
methods.setImageTexture: Sets texture file name or resource name to display.
methods.setImageTile: Sets width and height of an individual sprite tile within texture coordinate area.
methods.setItemResource: Loads and selects an image resource by name, returning true if found.
methods.setItemSelect: Selects active image item by index.

MyGUI.InputManager.description: Singleton manager handling mouse and keyboard input injection, widget focus, modality, and capture.

methods.addWidgetModal: Pushes the widget onto the modal stack, restricting input to it and its children.
methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton instance of InputManager.
methods.getKeyFocusWidget: Returns the widget currently holding keyboard focus, or nil if none.
methods.getMouseFocusWidget: Returns the widget currently under mouse focus, or nil if none.
methods.getMousePosition: Returns the current mouse cursor position (x, y) in screen coordinates.
methods.injectKeyPress: Injects a keyboard key press event (keycode, character code), returning true if consumed.
methods.injectKeyRelease: Injects a keyboard key release event (keycode), returning true if consumed.
methods.injectMouseMove: Injects mouse movement coordinates (x, y, wheel delta), returning true if consumed.
methods.injectMousePress: Injects a mouse button press event at coordinates (x, y, button), returning true if consumed.
methods.injectMouseRelease: Injects a mouse button release event at coordinates (x, y, button), returning true if consumed.
methods.isCaptureMouse: Returns whether any widget has currently captured mouse input.
methods.isControlPressed: Returns whether either Control key is currently held down.
methods.isFocusKey: Returns whether any widget currently has keyboard focus.
methods.isFocusMouse: Returns whether any widget currently has mouse focus.
methods.isModalAny: Returns whether any modal widget is currently active.
methods.isShiftPressed: Returns whether either Shift key is currently held down.
methods.removeWidgetModal: Removes the widget from the modal stack.
methods.resetKeyFocusWidget: Clears keyboard focus, optionally only if currently held by the specified widget.
methods.setKeyFocusWidget: Sets keyboard focus to the specified widget, or clears focus if nil.

MyGUI.InputManagerStatic.description: Static interface table for accessing the singleton MyGUI.InputManager instance.

methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton MyGUI.InputManager instance, or nil if uninitialized.

MyGUI.IntCoord.description: Represents a 2D integer pixel position and size combined into a bounding coordinate box.

methods.new: Constructs a new bounding coordinate instance (position and size) in integer pixel units.

properties.left: Horizontal pixel position of the top-left corner.
properties.top: Vertical pixel position of the top-left corner.
properties.x: Horizontal pixel position alias for left.
properties.y: Vertical pixel position alias for top.

MyGUI.IntCoordConstructor.description: Factory and constructor table for creating MyGUI.IntCoord value instances.

methods.new: Constructs a new IntCoord with the specified pixel left, top, width, and height (defaults to 0, 0, 0, 0).

MyGUI.IntPoint.description: Represents a 2D integer pixel coordinate point with horizontal and vertical components.

methods.new: Constructs a new coordinate value instance in integer pixel units.

properties.x: Horizontal pixel coordinate alias for left.
properties.y: Vertical pixel coordinate alias for top.

MyGUI.IntPointConstructor.description: Factory and constructor table for creating MyGUI.IntPoint value instances.

methods.new: Constructs a new IntPoint with the specified horizontal and vertical pixel coordinates (defaults to 0, 0).

MyGUI.IntRect.description: Represents an integer pixel bounding rectangle defined by left, top, right, and bottom borders.

methods.new: Constructs a new bounding rectangle instance (left, top, right, bottom) in integer pixel units.

properties.height: Calculated height of the rectangle in pixels (bottom - top).
properties.width: Calculated width of the rectangle in pixels (right - left).

MyGUI.IntRectConstructor.description: Factory and constructor table for creating MyGUI.IntRect value instances.

methods.new: Constructs a new IntRect with the specified pixel left, top, right, and bottom coordinates (defaults to 0, 0, 0, 0).

MyGUI.IntSize.description: Represents a 2D integer pixel size with width and height dimensions.

methods.new: Constructs a new dimension value instance in integer pixel units.

MyGUI.IntSizeConstructor.description: Factory and constructor table for creating MyGUI.IntSize value instances.

methods.new: Constructs a new IntSize with the specified pixel width and height (defaults to 0, 0).

MyGUI.ItemBox.description: Scrollable grid or list widget of customizable items supporting selection and drag-and-drop.

methods.addItem: Appends a new item entry to the end of the box.
methods.getIndexByWidget: Returns item index corresponding to the given item widget, or -1 when the widget is not an item.
methods.getIndexSelected: Returns index of selected item, or -1 when no item is selected.
methods.getItemCount: Returns total number of items in the box.
methods.getWidgetByIndex: Returns visible item widget at index, or nil if not visible or invalid.
methods.getWidgetDrag: Returns widget representation currently being dragged, or nil if none.
methods.insertItemAt: Inserts a new item entry at the specified index.
methods.redrawAllItems: Forces a redraw and update of all visible items in the box.
methods.redrawItemAt: Forces a redraw and update of the item at the specified index.
methods.removeAllItems: Removes all item entries from the box.
methods.removeItemAt: Removes item entry at the specified index.
methods.resetDrag: Resets the active item drag-and-drop state.
methods.setIndexSelected: Selects item at index. Pass a negative index to clear the selection.

MyGUI.LayerManager.description: Singleton manager organizing widgets into distinct rendering layers with defined Z-order and depth stacking.

methods.attachToLayerNode: Attaches a root widget to the named layer. Raises an error if the layer does not exist.
methods.detachFromLayer: Detaches the widget from its current layer.
methods.getByName: Returns the named layer. A missing layer raises an error unless throw is false, which returns nil instead.
methods.getCategoryName: Returns the configuration category name for layers ('Layer').
methods.getEnumerator: Returns an enumerator over a copy of the layers, in drawing order, taken now. A layer MyGUI replaces later is not detected, so walk the layers when you need them instead of keeping the enumerator.
methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton instance of LayerManager.
methods.getLayer: Returns the layer at a 0-based index, in drawing order. Raises an error for an index outside 0 to getLayerCount() - 1.
methods.getLayerCount: Returns total number of configured layers.
methods.getWidgetFromPoint: Returns the top visible and enabled widget at the screen position.
methods.isExist: Returns true if a layer with the specified name exists.
methods.upLayerItem: Moves the widget to the top of its layer.

MyGUI.LayerManagerStatic.description: Static interface table for accessing the singleton MyGUI.LayerManager instance.

methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton MyGUI.LayerManager instance, or nil if uninitialized.

MyGUI.LayoutManager.description: Singleton manager that parses and instantiates XML layout files into widget hierarchies.

methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton instance of LayoutManager.
methods.loadLayout: Loads an XML layout file, instantiating root widgets with an optional prefix and parent widget.
methods.unloadLayout: Destroys all widgets in the given layout table and frees their resources.

MyGUI.LayoutManagerStatic.description: Static interface table for accessing the singleton MyGUI.LayoutManager instance.

methods.getInstance: Returns the singleton MyGUI.LayoutManager instance, or nil if uninitialized.

MyGUI.ListBox.description: Scrollable vertical list widget for displaying and selecting items with support for scrolling, item lookup, and custom widgets.

methods.addItem: Appends a new item with the specified label to the end of the list.
methods.beginToItemAt: Scrolls the list so that the item at the specified index is visible.
methods.beginToItemFirst: Scrolls the list to display the first item.
methods.beginToItemLast: Scrolls the list to display the last item.
methods.beginToItemSelected: Scrolls the list so that the currently selected item is visible.
methods.findItemIndexWith: Searches for an item matching the specified label and returns its zero-based index, or -1 when the item is not found.
methods.getIndexSelected: Returns the zero-based index of the currently selected item, or -1 when no item is selected.
methods.getItemCount: Returns the total number of items in the list.
methods.getItemNameAt: Returns the label of the item at the specified zero-based index.
methods.getOptimalHeight: Calculates and returns the optimal height in pixels required to display all items without scrolling.
methods.getWidgetByIndex: Returns the child widget representing the item at the specified index, or nil if not currently rendered.
methods.insertItemAt: Inserts a new item with the specified label at the given zero-based index.
